findings.current: Didn’t I tell you, Second Brother, that we should approach slowly and gently?
findings.defect: The speaker calls himself the younger brother; he does not address the giant as Second Brother.
findings.rationale: 소제 is the speaker’s self-reference. Adding Second Brother changes whom he addresses.
findings.replacement: Didn’t your little brother tell you we should approach slowly and gently?
findings.source: 그러게 소제(小弟)가 천천히, 사근사근하게 접근하자고 하지 않았습니까.

findings.current: And on one of the dozens of winding hills, a group watched the scene from the shadows.
findings.defect: The group has the shadows behind them, not around them.
findings.rationale: 그림자를 등진 채 places the shadows at their backs; “from the shadows” reverses that position.
findings.replacement: And on one of the dozens of hills, a group watched the scene with their backs to the shadows.
findings.source: 그림자를 등진 채 그 광경을 지켜보는 일단의 무리가 있었다.

findings.current: The giant had rushed forward alone, leaving dozens of his subordinates behind. He’d survived the net of arrows that had densely covered a thirty-jang radius, and now he bellowed.
findings.defect: “Rushed” invents a sudden movement; the source says only that he had come forward alone.
findings.rationale: 홀로 앞서 나와 establishes his position ahead of the others, without specifying a rush.
findings.replacement: The giant stood ahead of his dozens of subordinates, alone. Having survived the net of arrows that had densely covered a thirty-jang radius, he bellowed.
findings.source: 수십여 명의 수하들을 뒤로하고 홀로 앞서 나와, 반경 삼십여 장을 빼곡히 뒤덮은 화망(火網)에서 살아남은 거한이 버럭 외쳤다.

findings.current: Why’s he waving around that bright yellow thing?
findings.defect: “Bright yellow” contradicts the cloth’s dirty, yellowish appearance.
findings.rationale: 싯누런 describes an unpleasant yellow, consistent with the cloth being covered in sand and loess.
findings.replacement: Why’s he waving around that dingy yellow thing?
findings.source: 싯누런 거 들고 뭘 보라는 건지.

summary: The draft is largely faithful, but it changes an addressee, reverses a physical position, and adds an unsupported movement.
